article.story: Texas A&M (4-6) at Oklahoma (6-4), Nov. 21 at 3:45 p.m. EST. Opening Line: Oklahoma by 7.5. Against the spread: Oklahoma 5-5, Texas A&M 4-6. How to watch: ESPN2 Key stats Oklahoma Offense Overall: 334.5 yards per game (116th in FBS) Passing: 215.9 yards per game (81st) Rushing: 118.6 yards per game (117th) Scoring: 22.3 points per game (106th) Oklahoma Defense Overall: 294.6 yards per game (19th in FBS) Passing: 166.3 yards per game (10th) Rushing: 128.3 yards per game (41st) Scoring: 19.0 points per game (26th) Texas A&M Offense Overall: 341.2 yards per game (109th in FBS) Passing: 187.7 yards per game (108th) Rushing: 153.5 yards per game (70th) Scoring: 24.2 points per game (95th) Texas A&M Defense Overall: 319.5 yards per game (29th in FBS) Passing: 182.5 yards per game (21st) Rushing: 137.0 yards per game (59th) Scoring: 19.0 points per game (26th) Texas A&M is 55th in third down percentage, converting 41.0% of the time. Oklahoma ranks 3rd on defense, allowing its opponents at convert at 28.2%. Texas A&M ranks 112th in FBS in red zone offense, scoring on 79.5% of trips. Oklahoma's red zone defense ranks 6th at 72.0%. Team leaders Oklahoma Passing: John Mateer, 2,153 yards, 15 TDs, 7 INTs, 64.5 completion percentage Rushing: Lloyd Avant, 440 yards on 107 carries, 2 TDs Receiving: Isaiah Sategna III, 628 yards on 50 catches, 4 TDs Texas A&M Passing: Marcel Reed, 1,712 yards, 8 TDs, 9 INTs, 55.7 completion percentage Rushing: Rueben Owens II, 508 yards on 107 carries, 1 TD Receiving: Isaiah Horton, 397 yards on 30 catches, 3 TDs Last game Oklahoma won 24-17 over Ole Miss on Nov. 15. Mateer led Oklahoma with 111 yards on 10-of-19 passing (52.6%) for no touchdowns and no interceptions. He also carried the ball 16 times for 70 yards and one rushing touchdown. Tory Blaylock carried the ball nine times for 48 yards, adding one reception for six yards. Rocky Beers put up 39 yards on four catches. Texas A&M lost 22-7 to Tennessee on Nov. 14. Reed led Texas A&M with 71 yards on 9-of-22 passing (40.9%) for no touchdowns and one interception. K.J. Edwards had 44 rushing yards on seven carries and one touchdown. Mario Craver had five receptions for 49 yards. Next game Oklahoma plays at Missouri on Nov. 28. Texas A&M hosts No. 8 Texas on Nov. 27.
